subject: Post-call: procurement path & next steps - Lumina Health
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: procurement path & next steps - Lumina Health

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so procurement has a single source of truth: 

What we heard from your team
- Use case: patient-facing summarization + secure embeddings for search across clinical FAQs.
- Expected Q1 pilot: ~5M tokens/month, modest concurrency.
- Security/controls: SOC 2 evidence and limited retention.

Open procurement questions we flagged
1) Preferred commercial path: PO (invoice / Net30), corporate card, or marketplace purchase?
2) Any vendor onboarding docs we should complete (W9, vendor form, insurance certificates)?
3) Timeline expectations for finance/IT approvals and signature authority.

Attachments: I attached an initial quote (PDF) and our W9. I also linked a short mutual action plan (MAP) we can iterate on.

Asks / next steps
- Can you confirm who owns vendor onboarding in your org (name + email) and whether Net30 is required?
- If marketplace is preferred, can procurement confirm the marketplace vendor flow that Lumina uses?
- If PO is the path, we can provide a PO-ready invoice and PO template review.

Proposed cadence: 15-min weekly check-ins until procurement clears (we can stop earlier). I’ll send a calendar stub once we confirm attendees.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that speeds things up.

—
Aditya Rao
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0187
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Park <sarah.park@luminahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement path & next steps - Lumina Health

Aditya — thanks for the clear recap. A few updates from our side: 

- Procurement route: our preferred path is an internal PO (Net30) for vendors, but we are evaluating marketplace first if pricing and terms align — Marketplace purchases speed up onboarding since finance treats them as catalog buys.
- Required docs: W9, SOC 2 summary (not always the full report), and supplier onboarding form (I attached the PDF our team uses).
- Timeline: finance will review vendor forms within 3-5 business days once we receive a complete packet; legal review only if bespoke terms are requested.

Procurement contact: James Lin (james.lin@luminahealth.com) — he handles vendor setup and PO issuance. Loop him on the packet so we don’t have to re-file.

I attached the supplier_onboarding_form.pdf in case you want to pre-fill. Also, can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a PO with Net30? And do you support marketplace purchase via the 'HealthCloud' marketplace?

Thanks,
Sarah
Director, Product Management — Lumina Health

Attachments: supplier_onboarding_form.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Lin <james.lin@luminahealth.com>, Sarah Park <sarah.park@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement path & next steps - Lumina Health

James / Sarah — looping in Neha from our finance & procurement team and Marissa from commercial for any pricing/terms clarifications.

Quick answers: 
- Yes, Redwood can accept a PO with Net30. We issue PO-ready invoices and have standard Net30 terms for enterprise customers (exceptions handled by commercial).
- Marketplace: we are listed on HealthCloud marketplace, which supports catalog purchases; pricing options can differ slightly (list vs. committed). If Lumina prefers the marketplace route it often removes the PO friction.

Attachments included: quote-Redwood-Lumina-20270322.pdf (line-item quote), W9-Redwood-Inc.pdf, and a short MAP draft (mutual_action_plan.pdf). I pre-filled several fields on the supplier onboarding form to save time.

Neha — can you confirm whether we can offer Net30 on the Mid-tier quote as-is or if we need a commercial review for extended credit?

If helpful, I can convert the quote into a PO-ready invoice template for James to paste into Lumina’s system.

Thanks,
Aditya

Attachments: quote-Redwood-Lumina-20270322.pdf, W9-Redwood-Inc.pdf, mutual_action_plan.pdf
From: procurement@luminahealth.com <procurement@luminahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Park <sarah.park@luminahealth.com>
Cc: James Lin <james.lin@luminahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup questions — Redwood Inference

Hi Aditya / team —

A few items to expedite vendor setup: 
1) Please provide a signed W9 (we need a PDF with a signature block) or confirm your tax EIN exactly as it should appear on the vendor record.
2) Insurance certificate (we typically require $1M general liability) — can you share or confirm where we can pull this from your vendor portal?
3) PO template: we’ll send our PO once vendor record is created. Can you confirm you accept standard Lumina PO language (Net30, no liability changes)?

Also: we prefer the marketplace route when integration with our procurement system (Coupa) is available, but marketplace only works if the vendor publishes a product SKU with a fixed price. If Redwood is willing to publish a SKU for the pilot price, that usually shortens time-to-PO to a day or two.

Please send the signed W9 and SOC 2 summary. Once we have those, I’ll start the vendor form and aim to issue a PO next week.

Thanks,
Lumina Procurement Team
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Lin <james.lin@luminahealth.com>, procurement@luminahealth.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup questions — Redwood Inference

James / Procurement team —

Thanks for the checklist. We’ve attached a signed W9 and a short SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). Aditya also included the MAP and the PDF quote earlier.

A couple operational notes to keep momentum: 
- We are happy to publish a pilot SKU for HealthCloud if that is the fastest path; Marissa can confirm the exact pilot pricing and SKU details.
- Net30 on PO is fine; no bespoke liability changes required for the pilot.
- We’ll schedule a 15-minute weekly status sync until the PO is in your system. Proposed weekly meeting (15 min): Thursdays 10:00 AM PT — I’ll send a calendar invite unless you prefer a different cadence.

Attachments: W9-Redwood-Inc.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
